items.html:
Bhargav Bhatt made a huge impact in his debut season, picking up 47 wickets in nine matches to lead the Ranji wicket-takers tally and steer Baroda to the finals. It capped a stunning rise for a bowler who until three years before his Ranji debut, was not even a regular in the Baroda Under-19 side. His Ranji exploits caught the eye of the IPL talent scouts, and he was drafted into the Kings XI Punjab side. He impressed in the home game against the higher-ranked Mumbai Indians, with a four-wicket haul that earned him the Man-of-the-Match award.
ESPNcricinfo staff, May 2011
